description:
Use this when the user wants a long video brought in to clip it: "clip this Twitch VOD", "turn my Kick
stream into shorts", or a file attached. A file that can't be attached is uploaded at https://ripclip.org.
Set rights only after the user confirms they own the video or may use it. To import and clip in one go, set
clip_max_hu to the HU the user approved: job_status then starts the clips and returns that job.
Not for: YouTube links (they attach or upload their own file) or a stream still live. Free to import;
clipping spends Horizon Units. Returns job_id for job_status.

PhotoFile.description: a file the user attached in ChatGPT (Apps SDK openai/fileParams: download_url and file_id always come)
PhotoFile.title: PhotoFile

channel.description: Streamer's name; imports their newest past broadcast. Needs platform

clip_count.description: Clips to cut when clip_max_hu is set, 1-10

clip_max_hu.description: HU the user approved to clip it as soon as it is imported (about 1 HU a minute); 0 = import only

file.description: A video the user attached in the chat; leave url empty

platform.description: kick or twitch; used with channel

request_key.description: Optional idempotency key; leave empty and RipClip makes one. Never ask the user

rights.description: Set true only after the user confirms they own the video or may use it

url.description: Link to a Kick or Twitch VOD, highlight or clip, a podcast episode, a Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share, or a direct video file; or a channel page like kick.com/name for its newest past broadcast. Empty if using channel or file

name: import_video
title: Import video
